cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git reset --hard'; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: git reset --hard irreversibly discards uncommitted work","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git reset --hard discards uncommitted work"}}'; fi
